source.panelVarianceNote: Other dynamically updated text on the same page showed $4,024.60/troy oz and $129.39/g at 7:10 p.m. ET, and a footer described the main panel as of 7:10 p.m. EDT. The calculator uses only the named Live GoldPrice panel's 19:11 NY bid and records the variance rather than blending values.

conversion.quote: A troy ounce is 31.1034768 grams — about 10% heavier than the avoirdupois ounce used for groceries.

formula.rounding: Retain full precision during arithmetic and round only displayed results. Cross-check the rounded 24K per-gram result to the source-displayed $129.41/g.
formula.actualNetMetalWeightRule: Never substitute listedWeightGrams for verified net metal weight. Catalog netMetalWeightGrams and actual raw-gold value remain blank.

benchmarkMethodology.quote: The internationally recognised benchmark price for gold delivered in London; Set twice daily (at 10:30 and 15:00 London UK time) in US dollars per troy ounce; Administered independently by ICE Benchmark Administration (IBA).
benchmarkMethodology.use: Methodology context only. No current LBMA numeric price was obtained or used in the calculator.

liveFeed.snapshotWarning: A spot feed reading, not a dealer quote, a resale offer or an appraisal. The calculator still uses the named Kitco Live GoldPrice panel below so its arithmetic stays reproducible against the audited snapshot; this reading is published beside it so the gap between the two is visible instead of hidden.

freshnessNote: The calculator reference (source) is the Kitco Live GoldPrice panel as of Oct 22, 2026 - 19:11 NY Time (bid $4,025.00 per troy ounce, displayed $129.41 per gram). An independent gold-api.com spot read on 2026-10-23T23:38:16Z published 3996.899902 USD per troy ounce ($3,996.899902 = 128.50 per gram). Both carry their own publisher timestamps; neither is blended, averaged or substituted.
